note: Two lists. `governed`: ids admitted one load at a time by a one-use grant bound to the entry's bytes, its release-relative path and its import closure (the demonstration module hello-governed). `pluginSet`: every AUKORA plugin a patch at the release root mounts (demo-governed excepted), whether or not a deployment lists that patch. The materializer records each one's files (scripts/aukora/plugin-set.mjs record) and refuses if the mounted rows and this list differ; the gate admits them only by the owner's Aumlok approval of exactly that record, and refuses a changed or unrecorded file at import. Upstream stock plugins and node_modules are NOT governed; see GOVERNED.md.
